name: devassist
description: Developer assistant: Jira and GitLab tools, AWS credentials, an @assist chat participant and skill folders for VS Code chat.

enumDescriptions: Jira Server/Data Center personal access token (Authorization: Bearer)
Jira Cloud API token (Authorization: Basic base64(email:token))

devassist.jira.email.description: Account email, only used when authType is 'basic' (Jira Cloud).

devassist.gitlab.baseUrl.description: GitLab base URL, e.g. https://gitlab.com or https://gitlab.company.com. The token is kept in the OS keychain: use the DevAssist sidebar or 'DevAssist: Set GitLab Token'.

devassist.aws.region.description: Default AWS region for the credentials saved in the DevAssist sidebar (used for the STS check and the AWS terminal).

languageModelTools.name: devassist_getJiraIssue
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get the summary, status, assignee and description of ONE Jira issue by key (e.g. PROJ-123). Use when the user mentions a ticket key.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Fetch a Jira issue by key.

languageModelTools.name: devassist_searchJira
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Search Jira with JQL. Returns up to 20 keys with summary and status. Prefer narrow JQL (project, assignee, status).

jql.description: JQL query, e.g. assignee = currentUser() AND resolution = Unresolved

languageModelTools.name: devassist_addJiraComment
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Post a comment on a Jira issue. This WRITES to Jira; only use when the user asked for it.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Post a comment on a Jira issue (asks for confirmation).

languageModelTools.name: devassist_listGitLabMergeRequests
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List GitLab merge requests (up to 20, newest activity first). Without project it searches every project the user can see; with project 'current' it uses the workspace repo. Defaults: state=opened, scope=assigned_to_me when no project is given. Use scope reviews_for_me for 'what do I need to review'.

project.description: Optional project path 'group/project', numeric ID, or 'current' for the workspace repo. Omit to search all projects.

scope.description: Whose MRs. Default assigned_to_me without a project, all with one.

search.description: Text to match in title or description

languageModelTools.name: devassist_getGitLabMergeRequest
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get ONE GitLab merge request by IID (the number after '!'): description, author, reviewers, merge status, conflicts, head pipeline status and changed files. Set includeDiffs to true to also get the diffs (truncated to ~30k chars) when reviewing code.

project.description: Project path 'group/subgroup/project' or numeric ID. Omit (or 'current') to use the GitLab repo open in the workspace.

includeDiffs.description: Include unified diffs of changed files

languageModelTools.name: devassist_listGitLabPipelines
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List the most recent CI pipelines of a GitLab project (up to 10), optionally filtered by branch/tag and status. Use to check whether a branch is green.

project.description: Project path 'group/subgroup/project' or numeric ID. Omit (or 'current') to use the GitLab repo open in the workspace.

languageModelTools.name: devassist_getGitLabPipelineJobs
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List the jobs of one GitLab pipeline with stage, status and failure reason. Use after listing pipelines to find which job failed, then read its log with devassist_getGitLabJobLog.
languageModelTools.userDescription: List jobs in a GitLab pipeline.

project.description: Project path 'group/subgroup/project' or numeric ID. Omit (or 'current') to use the GitLab repo open in the workspace.

languageModelTools.name: devassist_getGitLabJobLog
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get the last lines of a GitLab CI job log (default 200, max 1000), with colour codes stripped. Use to explain why a job failed.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Read the tail of a GitLab CI job log.

project.description: Project path 'group/subgroup/project' or numeric ID. Omit (or 'current') to use the GitLab repo open in the workspace.

lines.description: How many lines from the end (default 200)

languageModelTools.name: devassist_listGitLabIssues
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List GitLab issues (up to 20). Without project it searches every project the user can see; defaults: state=opened, scope=assigned_to_me when no project is given.

project.description: Optional project path, numeric ID, or 'current'. Omit to search all projects.

search.description: Text to match in title or description

languageModelTools.name: devassist_searchGitLabProjects
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Find GitLab projects the user is a member of by name. Returns the 'group/project' path and ID to pass to the other GitLab tools.

search.description: Part of the project name or path

languageModelTools.name: devassist_commentOnGitLabMergeRequest
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Post a comment on a GitLab merge request. This WRITES to GitLab; only use when the user asked for it. Needs a token with the api scope.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Post a comment on a GitLab merge request (asks for confirmation).

project.description: Project path 'group/subgroup/project' or numeric ID. Omit (or 'current') to use the GitLab repo open in the workspace.

languageModelTools.name: devassist_loadSkill
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Load the full instructions of a named skill from the skills index, or a supporting file inside it. Call this before following a skill.

file.description: Optional relative file inside the skill folder, e.g. rollback.md

chatParticipants.name: assist
chatParticipants.description: Ask about Jira, GitLab merge requests and pipelines, skills…

commands.name: reviews
commands.description: GitLab merge requests waiting for my review, and my own open ones
